description: The fifth, and an empty sixth

participation.context: Sat the hour with the almanac on his knee and made no mark.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Preached, and turned the sand-glass twice.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Sat three pews ahead, turned away, and did not speak.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

story.body: You held the almanac through both turns of the glass. You did not mark the sixth. You did not write down the sermon.

title: Kept the parish hour

description: A bad example, and after Thursday

participation.context: Told the plot, separated the two sums, and stayed for Sunday.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Called it a bad example, priced the loaf and the board, and named the sixpence for the morning.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Said Thursday was three days old, and reported the loaf a full thumb short.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Said a bad tooth takes rent of the head, and named Monday's shuttle.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

participation.context: Put a paw on the loaf and was told to come off it.
participation.name: Gib

relations.note: she takes the plot and keeps last Sunday's word
relations.quote: Then I don't call that a play, I call it a bad example.

story.body: You gave her the three steps and let the verdict stand. You kept the share apart from the box. You did not walk to the barber. You named tomorrow's sixpence and tomorrow's Roman.

relations.note: she takes the plot and keeps last Sunday's word
relations.quote: Then I don't call that a play, I call it a bad example.

title: Told the king in three steps at dinner

description: Saturday's line, and the book shut

participation.context: Read the line, wrote nothing, and shut the book.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Lay at the corner of the table while the book was open, and stayed when it shut.
participation.name: Gib

story.body: You read last night's line and did not rule under it. You shut the book. The forty-five shillings stay a share.

title: Read the share and shut the book
